source.publication: 2025 Complete Income Tax Instruction Booklet (ip25), Kansas Department of Revenue, with Form K-40 and Schedule S bound in (PDF pages 19-22)
source.section: Form K-40 lines 1-12 (ip25 PDF page 20; exemption block PDF page 19); K-40 instructions lines 1-3 (PDF page 6), line 4 and exemptions (PDF page 6), lines 5-8 (PDF page 7); Schedule S line A14 (ip25 PDF page 21), instructions PDF page 12 'Retirement benefits specifically exempt from Kansas Income Tax', first bullet; FAQ 'Are military pensions taxable to Kansas?'; tax rate schedule: 2025 Tax Computation Worksheet (PDF page 34) and Tax Table (PDF pages 27-34)

worked: Federal AGI = wages (you) 60,000.00 + military pension (you) 30,000.00 = 90,000.00. Federal taxable income = 90,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 (15,750.00) = 74,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored; federal figures are given, not tested; Kansas starts from federal AGI). Schedule S Part A: line A1 0.00; lines A2-A8 0.00; line A9 total additions 0.00. Line A10 0.00; lines A11-A13 0.00; line A14 retirement benefits specifically exempt: military retirement pay 30,000.00 = 30,000.00; lines A15-A25 0.00; line A26 total subtractions = 30,000.00; line A27 net modification = 0.00 - 30,000.00 = -30,000.00. Form K-40: line 1 federal AGI 90,000.00; line 2 modifications -30,000.00; line 3 Kansas AGI = 90,000.00 + (-30,000.00) = 60,000.00; line 4 standard deduction (single) 3,605.00; line 5 exemption allowance (1 exemption) 9,160.00, 0 dependents; line 6 total deductions = 3,605.00 + 9,160.00 = 12,765.00; line 7 taxable income = 60,000.00 - 12,765.00 = 47,235.00; line 8 tax (rate schedule as numbers, PDF page 34): 5.2% x 23,000.00 = 1,196.00 + 5.58% x (47,235.00 - 23,000.00 = 24,235.00) = 1,352.3130; total 2,548.3130 = 2,548.31. Line 7 is 100,000 or less, so the form reads the tax table: row 47,201-47,250, single, head of household or married filing separate column, PDF page 30, gives 2,548; expected keeps the formula figure. Lines 9-10 do not apply (resident); line 11 0.00; line 12 total income tax 2,548.31. Credits (lines 13-15, 17): none, 0.00; state income tax = 2,548.31. Age 45, still working: no age or income test. The disabled veteran exemption is not modelled and does not apply to this household.
accepted_approximations: Tax is computed from the rates, not the printed tables and rounded worksheet subtraction.
